title: Rat King: does Battle Vest weapon damage raise Scrap Grenade damage (and only above 65% health)?
question: Battle Vest BaseAttackDamagePercent 18 (ConditionallyApplied above 65% health) feeds EBaseWeaponDamageIncrease; Scrap Grenade = 70(+70 T2) + 0.6x that per detonation. Is it applied to grenade hits?
hypothesis: Yes: +10.8 per detonation above 65% health, +0 below. REFUTED if within 3 damage above 65%.

setup.level_or_boons: same level all arms (lvlhold), grenade T2 via abil bits 7

controls: same level so the weapon investment bonus is equal (A has 4.8k gun, B/C add only health colour)
procedure: throw one grenade at the dummy

decision.rule: SUPPORTS Battle Vest at 6.4k if B-A is 8-14 and C-A within 3; REFUTES if B-A within 3 (then Battle Vest is resist-only and its slot is re-priced).
